name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent above $110 as Hormuz stays largely closed
state: Brent last settled at $113 on 30 Oct, above the $110 Alert line and up 11% over the month. Iran said four tankers caught fire after striking mines near Hormuz on 31 Oct, and Iran halted tanker movements the same day. In Doha talks Tehran has offered to reopen the strait within two days, on conditions the US has not accepted.
for_you: Expect continued high petrol, diesel and heating-oil prices, with knock-on effects on transport costs and inflation.
rubric_hit: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
